40011067.author: पदार्थः
40011067.content: तीक्ष्णतुण्डः sharpbeaked, महास्वनः loudvoiced, गृध्रः vulture, तथा like that, अङ्गदस्य of Angada, मुखोद्गतम् came from the mouth, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

40011067.author: Translation
40011067.content: On hearing the words that came from Angada's mouth, the sharpbeaked, loudvoiced vulture (Sampati) said:

40011068.author: पदार्थः
40011068.content: मे my, प्राणैः with life, प्रियतमस्य dearest, भ्रातुः brother's, जटायुषः Jatayu's, वधम् death, मे my, मनः mind, कम्पयन्निव shaking, गिरा with a word, घोषयति loudly proclaims, अयम् this, कः who is that?

40011068.author: Translation
40011068.content: 'Who is it that was Pronouncing loudly the death of my dearest brother Jatayu? This news has shaken my mind.

40011069.author: पदार्थः
40011069.content: जनस्थाने at Janasthana, राक्षसगृध्रयोः between the demon and the vulture, युद्धम् fight, कथम् how, आसीत् took place, भ्रातुः brother's, इदं नामधेयम् this name, मया by me, अद्य today, चिरस्य श्रुतम् heard after a long time.

40011069.author: Translation
40011069.content: 'I heard my brother's name today after a long time.I wish to know how the demon and the vulture fought at Janasthana.

40011070.author: पदार्थः
40011070.content: गिरिदुर्गात् from the inaccessible mountain, भवद्भि: by all of you, अवतारितुम् to help to get down, इच्छेयम् I wish, गुणज्ञस्य of the virtuous, विक्रमैः with valour, श्लाघनीयस्य of the praiseworthy, यवीयसः younger brother, अतिदीर्घस्य after a long, कालस्य time, कीर्तनात् by a mention, परितुष्टः अस्मि I am very glad.

40011070.author: Translation
40011070.content: 'I wish to be brought down from this inaccessible mountain peak by all of you. I am glad to have heard from you the name of my younger brother after a long time. He is virtuous, valiant and praiseworthy.

40011071.author: पदार्थः
40011071.content: वानरर्षभाः O bulls among monkeys, तत् therefore, अहम् I, जनस्थान्निवासिनः of the inhabitant of Janasthana, भ्रातुः brother's, तस्य his, जटायुषः Jatayu's, विनाशम् death, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छेयम् I am desirous.

40011071.author: Translation
40011071.content: 'O bulls among monkeys I desire to hear about the death of my brother Jatayu, who was dwelling at Janasthana.

40011072.author: पदार्थः
40011072.content: गुरुजनप्रियः loved by elders, रामः Rama, यस्य whose, प्रियः favourite one, ज्येष्ठः पुत्रः eldest son, मम भ्रातुः my brother's, तस्यैव of him alone, सखा friend, दशरथः Dasaratha, कथम् how.

40011072.author: Translation
40011072.content: 'How did Dasaratha develop friendship with my brother? I hear that Rama who is the favourite firstborn of Dasaratha has endeared himself to all elders.

40011073.author: पदार्थः
40011073.content: अरिन्दमाः O tamers of enemies, सूर्यांशुदग्धपक्षत्वात् due to the burning of my wings by the Sun's rays, उपसर्पितुम् to move forward, न शक्नोमि it is not possible for me, अस्मात् from this, पर्वतात् from the mountain, अवतर्तुम् to get down, इच्छेयम् I want.

40011073.author: Translation
40011073.content: 'O tamers of foes as my wings are burnt down by the Sun's rays it is not possible for me to move forward. I wish you help me to get down from this mountain'.

40011074.author: पदार्थः
40011074.content: हरियूथपाः leaders among monkeys, शोकात् owing to grief, भ्रष्टस्वरमपि even if he had his voice had been choked, तद्वाक्यम् his words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, तस्य his, कर्मणा by the intention, शङ्किताः suspicious, नैव श्रद्दधुः they did not believe.

40011074.author: Translation
40011074.content: The leaders among monkeys did not trust his words even though his voice was choked with grief. They suspected his intentions.

40011075.author: पदार्थः
40011075.content: प्रायम् fasting unto death, उपविष्टाः seated, ते प्लवङ्गमाः those monkeys, गृध्रम् vulture, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, तदा then, नः us, सर्वान् all, भक्षयिष्यति he will eat away, रौद्रम् terribly, बुद्धिम् in their minds, चक्रुः  thought .

40011075.author: Translation
40011075.content: On seeing the vulture, the monkeys fasting unto death got a terrible thought in their minds that the vulture might eat them.

40011076.author: पदार्थः
40011076.content: प्रायम् आसीनान् welcoming death, नः us, भक्षयिष्यति यदि if he eats us away, इतः from here, क्षिप्रम् soon, सिद्धिम् accomplishment, गताः attained, सर्वथा by all means, कृतकृत्याः we succeed in our objective, भविष्यामः we will be.

40011076.author: Translation
40011076.content: 'Since we wish to die, we will be accomplishing our objective successfully if he eats us soon'.

40011077.author: पदार्थः
40011077.content: ततः then, सर्वे all, ते वानरर्षाभाः those heroic monkeys, एताम् this way, बुद्धिम् thought, चक्रुः they entertained, तदा then, अङ्गदः Angada, गृध्रम् vulture, गिरेः mountain's, शृङ्गात् from the peak, अवतार्य having brought down, आह he said.

40011077.author: Translation
40011077.content: Thus thought the chief among the monkeys. Angada having helped the vulture come down the mountain peak, said:

40011078.author: पदार्थः
40011078.content: पक्षिन् O bird, प्रतापवान् powerful, वानरेन्द्रः king of monkeys, मम my, आर्यः revered ancestor, ऋक्षरजा Riksharaja's, नाम named, पार्थिवः a king, बभूव was, ओघबलौ strong like flood water, उभौ both, सुग्रीवश्चैव Sugriva, वाली च and Vali, तस्य his, धार्मिकौ righteous, आत्मजौ पुत्रौ his two sons, मम my, पिता father, वाली Vali, लोके in the world, विश्रुतकर्मा famous by his great deeds, राजा king, अभूत् was.

40011078.author: Translation
40011078.content: 'O powerful bird my revered grandfather Riksharaja was a glorious king of monkeys. He had two sons called Sugriva and Vali.Both were strong like floodwaters. My father Vali was wellknown in this world for his remarkable deeds.

40011079.author: पदार्थः
40011079.content: पक्षिन् O bird, प्रतापवान् powerful, वानरेन्द्रः king of monkeys, मम my, आर्यः revered ancestor, ऋक्षरजा Riksharaja's, नाम named, पार्थिवः a king, बभूव was, ओघबलौ strong like flood water, उभौ both, सुग्रीवश्चैव Sugriva, वाली च and Vali, तस्य his, धार्मिकौ righteous, आत्मजौ पुत्रौ his two sons, मम my, पिता father, वाली Vali, लोके in the world, विश्रुतकर्मा famous by his great deeds, राजा king, अभूत् was.

40011079.author: Translation
40011079.content: 'O powerful bird my revered grandfather Riksharaja was a glorious king of monkeys. He had two sons called Sugriva and Vali.Both were strong like floodwaters. My father Vali was wellknown in this world for his remarkable deeds.

40011080.author: पदार्थः
40011080.content: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of Ikshvaku race, महारथः great warrior, कृत्स्नस्य of the entire, जगतः world, राजा king, श्रीमान् illustrious, दाशरथिः Dasaratha's son, रामः Rama's, पितुः father's, निदेशनिरतः obeying his command, धर्म्यम् righteous, पन्थानम् path, आश्रितः seeking, भ्रात्रा with his brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह along with Lakshmana, भार्यया with his wife, वैदेह्या चापि and with Vaidehi, दण्डकावनम् forest of Dandaka, प्रविष्टः he entered.

40011080.author: Translation
40011080.content: 'The great warrior Rama is the son of Dasaratha, the scion of the Ikshvaku race and the king of the entire world. He entered Dandaka forest along with his brother Lakshmana and consort Vaidehi obeying his father's command following a righteous path.

40011081.author: पदार्थः
40011081.content: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of Ikshvaku race, महारथः great warrior, कृत्स्नस्य of the entire, जगतः world, राजा king, श्रीमान् illustrious, दाशरथिः Dasaratha's son, रामः Rama's, पितुः father's, निदेशनिरतः obeying his command, धर्म्यम् righteous, पन्थानम् path, आश्रितः seeking, भ्रात्रा with his brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह along with Lakshmana, भार्यया with his wife, वैदेह्या चापि and with Vaidehi, दण्डकावनम् forest of Dandaka, प्रविष्टः he entered.

40011081.author: Translation
40011081.content: 'The great warrior Rama is the son of Dasaratha, the scion of the Ikshvaku race and the king of the entire world. He entered Dandaka forest along with his brother Lakshmana and consort Vaidehi obeying his father's command following a righteous path.

40011082.author: पदार्थः
40011082.content: तस्य his, भार्या wife, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, रावणेन by Ravana, बलात् with force, हृता is abducted, रामस्य Rama's, पितुः father's, मित्रम् friend, जटायुर्नाम called Jatayu, गृध्रराट् king of vultures, विहायसा flying through aerial region, ह्रियमाणाम्  forcibly taken away, वैदेहीम् princess of Videha, सीताम् Sita, ददर्श he saw.

40011082.author: Translation
40011082.content: 'His wife was abducted from Janasthana by Ravana. The king of vultures Jatayu, a friend of Rama's father observed princess of Videha, being forcibly carried away through the aerial region.

40011083.author: पदार्थः
40011083.content: रावणम् Ravana, विरथम् deprived of the chariot, कृत्वा after defeating, मैथिलीं च and Maithili, स्थापयित्वा putting her at a place, परिश्रान्तश्च exhausted one, वृद्धश्च and old one also, रणे in combat, रावणेन by Ravana, हतः was killed.

40011083.author: Translation
40011083.content: 'Jatayu destroyed Ravana's aerial chariot and put Maithili in a (safe) place. But being old and exhausted, he was killed in a combat by Ravana.

40011084.author: पदार्थः
40011084.content: गृध्रः vulture, एवम् that way, बलीयसा by a stronger one, तेन रावणेन by that Ravana, हतः slain, रामेण by Rama, संस्कृतश्चासि cremated according to rites, उत्तमां गतिम् supreme abode, गतश्च reached.

40011084.author: Translation
40011084.content: 'Thus the vulture was slain by Ravana who was stronger. Cremated by Rama and his last rites performed, he reached the supreme heavenly abode. (It was the luck of Jatayu, unlike Dasaratha, to be cremated by Rama.)

40011085.author: पदार्थः
40011085.content: ततः then, राघवः Rama, मम my, पितृव्येण with my father's brother, महात्मना by the great self, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, सख्यम् friendship, चकार made, सः he, Rama, पितरम् my father, अवधीत् killed.

40011085.author: Translation
40011085.content: 'Then Rama made friendship with my father's brother, great self Sugriva and killed my father.
